memory_note: Absolute RSS is dominated by imported libraries (the CLI imports torch and transformers to record the environment), so the figure that supports the constant-memory claim is streaming_phase_memory_delta_mb: the growth attributable to streaming the whole FASTA. peak_process_memory_mb additionally covers the post-hoc exact-statistics pass, which deliberately reads metadata columns back in to compute exact order statistics rather than approximating them.

notes.padding: No padding is applied at any point. Reads enter the encoder at their true length.
notes.ambiguity_policy: longest_unambiguous_run keeps the longest contiguous ACGT stretch; it never substitutes or invents a base.
notes.case: Sequences are uppercased; case carries no information in this dataset.
